cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Started the Spiral
cards.instruction: Hide how much your own fear or resentment created the emotional crisis while helping everyone calm it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll calm the committee. The money's in the other envelope.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You phoned me crying that the treasurer had stolen it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll start with you. It's all here; will you tell the others?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I told them exactly what you said. The treasurer's furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll ring her first. Stay on with me and call it a balance check.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 confidently promises calm; A3 recruits B to relay reassurance; A5 takes the angry treasurer first but needs B on the call to disguise the panic as accounting.

responseLogic.evidence: A1 found money contradicts the earlier accusation reported by B2, not a current fact; B4 explains the treasurer anger through exact repetition.

relationship.evidence: B2 remembers the tearful allegation and B4 reports its reputational consequence.

heightening.evidence: B4 furious treasurer changes A5 first call and makes B support more necessary.

specificity.evidence: A1 committee money, B2 treasurer and B4 circulated allegation establish the immediate crisis.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 names the changed call order and asks B for support with a face-saving label; no additional explanation of the cover-up.
